duration.text: The Software Engineering at Chongqing University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 9. Academic Reference 10.Personal Statement 11.Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. 12.Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).

requirements.text: 1.Be in good Health 2.Non-Chinese citizen 3.applicant should be less than 45 4.Bachelor's degree holder or above 5.English Proficiency: TOEFL or IELTS minimum requirements is 550 points or above for TOEFL, and a grade 6.0 or above for IELTS, or other certificate of English proficiency from an approved test. Native English speakers are exempt from this requirement;other candidates whose University courses are taught in English will be considered case by case. Professional Backgrounds: Applicants with relevant professional experience or other qualifications deemed appropriciate to the programme applied for may also be considered.
